review_boundary: C1/C2 only; C3 access summary and final handoff were not reviewed.

findings.title: As-of derivation admits future attempt, source, nested access, and browser clocks
evidence: packages/normalization/src/field-observation.mjs:316-330 sorts and filters by observed_at/recorded_at only; attempted_at and source_observed_at are not part of eligibility or ordering.
packages/normalization/src/field-observation.mjs:408-435 repeats the same parent filter and then selects access facts and browser observations without filtering their own timestamps.
packages/normalization/src/field-observation.mjs:173-216 and packages/normalization/schemas/field-observation.schema.json:48-51,81-87 validate timestamp shape/presence but no temporal ordering.
findings.impact: A valid observation with observed_at and recorded_at before as_of but attempted_at after as_of can become the historical current state; future nested access or browser outcomes can enter an access summary. PR005 freshness and C004 last-attempt views cannot rely on the as-of boundary.
findings.required_correction: Define and enforce ordering/as-of rules for source, observation, recording, attempt, access-fact, and browser clocks; add adversarial future-clock fixtures.

findings.title: Revision history is not self-contained or provenance-complete
evidence: packages/normalization/src/field-observation.mjs:288-300 historySnapshot retains value/state/reason/time fields but omits evidence_refs, endpoint_scope, recorded_at, access_facts, and browser observations.

packages/normalization/src/field-observation.mjs:303-309 appends that reduced snapshot, while :322-346 deriveFieldObservation computes historical_success only from the separate observations array and never traverses history.
findings.impact: If a current failed revision is persisted with its public history only, deriveFieldObservation([current]) cannot recover the earlier success or its evidence and endpoint provenance. The existing test passes both full historical and failed objects (lines 128-140), so it does not prove persisted-history recovery.
findings.required_correction: Retain immutable references or a complete historical snapshot (including evidence/endpoint/recording provenance) and make derivation consume that history; validate revision identity and ordering.

findings.title: Endpoint and browser scope boundaries are declared but not enforced
evidence: packages/normalization/src/field-observation.mjs:92-99 permits null endpoint/resource and operation other for every observation; :251-284 defaults to that unscoped value.
packages/normalization/src/field-observation.mjs:187-193 readiness ignores endpoint scope, and :203-211 validates browser shape without requiring browser_read operation.
packages/normalization/src/field-observation.mjs:408-451 emits latest successful checks and the payload-access boundary without rejecting an unscoped or operation-mismatched attempt.
findings.impact: An unscoped succeeded observation can satisfy the readiness predicate and appear as a successful access summary; a browser observation can carry a non-browser operation. This conflicts with C004-3's endpoint/resource/operation contract and the emitted payload_access_requires_endpoint_scoped_attempt_evidence boundary.
findings.required_correction: Require operation-specific endpoint scope for successful payload/browser outcomes, or classify unscoped outcomes as non-success/unknown; add negative fixtures for null scope and wrong browser operation.

findings.title: Readiness promotes candidate, ambiguous, and disputed evidence
evidence: packages/coverage/research-program/v1.0.0/src/completeness.mjs:187-193 blocks evidence_state unknown but permits candidate, ambiguous, disputed, and documented when value/applicability/attempt otherwise pass.
packages/normalization/src/field-observation.mjs:6-9 declares those evidence states; docs/WP11_PUBLIC_UI_FOUNDATION.md:12 says candidate or ambiguous evidence is never promoted.
findings.impact: A known, supported, succeeded field with candidate or ambiguous evidence can make a record ready. This allows the machine readiness projection to promote evidence the project contract keeps unqualified.
findings.required_correction: Define the evidence states that are eligible for ready (at minimum exclude candidate/ambiguous/disputed), preserve the other state as not_ready or unknown, and add readiness negatives.

findings.title: Independent view validation does not rederive exact denominators or generation/clock context
evidence: packages/coverage/research-program/v1.0.0/src/completeness.mjs:237-291 builds field/source/readiness metrics, but :393-403 checks only partition sum, rate range, internal membership/denominator echoes, and a broad denominator <= membership_count*100 bound.

packages/coverage/research-program/v1.0.0/src/completeness.mjs:405-439 does not check numerator_count against the numerator partition, rate against numerator/denominator, partition_states against partitions, metric cohort/generation/as_of/denominator_status against the view, or membership source_counts/isolated counts against vectors.

packages/coverage/research-program/v1.0.0/src/completeness.mjs:294-348 copies each field observation's source_observed_at without requiring a relationship to sourceVector.source_observed_at; :368-383 accepts caller-supplied membership/generation and self-hashes it.
findings.impact: The producer calculation is internally plausible for valid input, but an independently rehashed artifact can carry a wrong field/source denominator, numerator/rate, metric generation, or source-vector clock and still pass assertCompletenessView. A consumer has no expected membership/context parameter in the verifier to bind the full vector to the frozen input.
findings.required_correction: Recompute expected per-field/per-source/readiness denominators and all metric arithmetic/context from the full vector, validate summary counts and source-clock relations, and accept an externally sealed expected membership/context identity where required.

positive_coverage: C1 tests cover known false versus unknown, identifier unit null, required attempted_at, retained historical value when both revisions are supplied, documented access facts, unknown cost/quota null, and credential placeholder rejection.

C2 tests cover isolated-record retention, missing placeholders, full field vector length for generated views, partition sums for selected metrics, cohort/generation on one rate context, digest mismatch rejection, bounded paging, and null rates for unknown denominator.
test_gaps: No derive-from-current-history-only fixture and no historical evidence/endpoint preservation assertion.
No unscoped attempted outcome or browser operation mismatch fixture.
No mutation/rebinding checks for metric arithmetic, exact field/source denominators, summary source counts/isolated counts, metric context, or source-vector clock binding.

normalization.PR005_use: Use deriveFieldObservation for current/historical state and buildAccessSummary for as-of endpoint-scoped latest success/attempt plus browser/access boundaries; preserve each returned evidence/time field until the clock and scope gaps are corrected.

coverage.PR005_use: Consume the full records/source_vectors/field observations and metric context through createOfflineCompletenessConsumer; treat aggregates as supplemental until denominator/context binding is strengthened.
coverage.PR007_use: Carry source_id, field observation evidence_refs/source_locator, source_observed_at, generation/as_of, and membership_hash when binding source-native release/distribution candidates; no release identity binding is supplied by this PR.
